topic: Post 5 photos of your work to your Google listing

script.hook: Your Google listing needs 5 photos. Now.
beats: Open Google Maps, find your listing, hit Add Photo.
Upload 5 real shots of your work, team, or location.
More photos mean more clicks. Google rewards active listings.
